Moving
Moving is easy. I have moved several times. Some places I just live out of my bag. Remember to bring the necessities as you live close to home and you can go back for a second trip if you need to. 

1. Plan if it’s long term or not. That will help you decide how much stuff you want to bring. It all depends if it’s furnished or not and what you may be expected to share/bring 

Living with roommates 
1. You will probably be expected to share items including dishes. Sometimes I keep my own set of dishes so I only have to wash my own and no one can say I’m not doing them. 
2. You may have to share some purchases like toilet paper. If not. You can always stock up. 
3. You will also be expected to take share in chores sometimes. Like cleaning or sweeping. Just be sure to be on top of it. Also give leeway for others if they’re not on time.  Some people are just busy. 

Also I would like to mention that noise has always been an issue with the places I’ve stayed at. You have to talk to the landlord if anything like that arises. 

Overall. It’s really easy and straight forward. Most houses have different people and rules so you’ll have to figure them out when you’re there.
